findings.desc: dead code: docs-drift-wrapper-root-smoke.ts:325 void gitRoot is a no-op — gitRoot is already used at line 288 (repoRoot: gitRoot), so the void expression does nothing. Copy-paste artifact from proof (1) where gitRoot was unused.

CHK-003 userSees says `lattice validate` runs the strengthened gitroot-cwd-contract guard green, but the `test:gitroot-cwd-contract` script is NOT in the root `npm test` chain (only `test:docs-drift-wrapper-root` was added). `lattice validate` calls `npm test`, which does not include `test:gitroot-cwd-contract`. The guard can only run via `npm run test:gitroot-cwd-contract` or `npm run test:all`. Fix: add `npm run test:gitroot-cwd-contract` to the root `test` chain in package.json (alongside `test:docs-drift-wrapper-root`).
